title: Checks for usage of crate as opposed to $crate in a macro definition.
summary: crate refers to the macro call’s crate, whereas $crate refers to the macro definition’s crate. Rarely is the former intended. See: https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/macros-by-example.html#hygiene Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks usage of std::fs::create_dir and suggest using std::fs::create_dir_all instead.
summary: Sometimes std::fs::create_dir is mistakenly chosen over std::fs::create_dir_all, resulting in failure when more than one directory needs to be created or when the directory already exists. Crates which never need to specifically create a single directory may wish to prevent this mistake. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for transmutes between a type T and *T.
summary: It’s easy to mistakenly transmute between a type and a pointer to that type. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.
